name: How long does structural wall framing typically take for a home addition?

mainEntity.name: How long does structural wall framing typically take for a home addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of structural wall framing for a home addition varies significantly based on the size and complexity of the project. For a small, straightforward addition, framing might take 1-3 weeks. Larger or more complex additions, especially those involving multiple stories or intricate designs, could extend to 4-8 weeks or longer. This timeline does not include design, permitting, foundation work, or subsequent finishing stages. Our team provides a detailed project schedule after initial assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Framing for a home addition typically takes 1-3 weeks for small projects and 4-8+ weeks for larger ones, depending on complexity.
